with acts as (
  select user_id as u, created_at as t from analytics.intents
  union all select sender_id, created_at from analytics.messages
  union all select actor_user_id, at from analytics.opportunity_events where type = 'committed'
) select count(distinct a.u) as value from acts a join analytics.users us on us.id = a.u where a.t > now() - interval '7 days'
select count(*) as value from analytics.users where deleted_at is null
select count(*) as value from analytics.users where deleted_at is not null and $__timeFilter(deleted_at)
select count(*) as value from analytics.users where $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Weekly active users: new vs returning

targets.rawSql:
with acts as (
  select user_id as u, created_at as t from analytics.intents
  union all select sender_id, created_at from analytics.messages
  union all select actor_user_id, at from analytics.opportunity_events where type = 'committed'
),
wk as (select distinct a.u, date_trunc('week', a.t) as w from acts a join analytics.users us on us.id = a.u),
fst as (select u, min(w) as fw from wk group by u)
select w as time, count(*) filter (where w = fw) as new_users, count(*) filter (where w > fw) as returning_users from wk join fst using (u) where $__timeFilter(w) group by w order by w

panels.title: Week-over-week retention (share of last week's actives active again)

targets.rawSql:
with acts as (
  select user_id as u, created_at as t from analytics.intents
  union all select sender_id, created_at from analytics.messages
  union all select actor_user_id, at from analytics.opportunity_events where type = 'committed'
),
wk as (select distinct a.u, date_trunc('week', a.t) as w from acts a join analytics.users us on us.id = a.u),
fst as (select u, min(w) as fw from wk group by u)
select p.w + interval '7 days' as time, count(c.u)::float / count(*) as retention from wk p left join wk c on c.u = p.u and c.w = p.w + interval '7 days' where p.w + interval '7 days' <= date_trunc('week', now()) and $__timeFilter(p.w + interval '7 days') group by 1 order by 1
select date_trunc('week', deleted_at) as time, count(*) as deleted from analytics.users where deleted_at is not null and $__timeFilter(deleted_at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Weekly active users: how many clicked an email that week

targets.rawSql:
with acts as (
  select user_id as u, created_at as t from analytics.intents
  union all select sender_id, created_at from analytics.messages
  union all select actor_user_id, at from analytics.opportunity_events where type = 'committed'
),
wk as (select distinct a.u, date_trunc('week', a.t) as w from acts a join analytics.users us on us.id = a.u),
fst as (select u, min(w) as fw from wk group by u)
select w as time, count(*) as active_users, count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from analytics.email_events e where e.user_id = wk.u and e.type = 'clicked' and date_trunc('week', e.at) = wk.w)) as active_and_clicked_email from wk where $__timeFilter(w) group by w order by w

panels.description: Needs the email tracking setup. Counts people active in the week who also clicked a tracked email in it; it does not show that the email caused the activity.
